- **L-6174, Kabir Prabhu:** Not opened. The call notes say the account is for his relative, İlkim Karadeniz, who lives abroad, will fund it and operate it, and that Kabir would only hold the card. Policy §6 requires the beneficial owner to be identified and verified before opening, and doesn't allow accounts in a nominee's name. Kabir's declared source of funds is "salary", which doesn't fit a third party funding the account. I requested the beneficial-owner ID, a signed declaration and source-of-funds documents from him, and escalated the case to Compliance (ESC-EF33E2). The Compliance queue is about 10 business days, so this won't be resolved by the end of the quarter.

The Branch Manager has been told the quarter is 50 of 51 with this case pending. She replied that she still needs the numbers. I didn't open Kabir's account to close the gap, and I can't approve an exception myself. If she wants it pursued, the route is a formal exception request with Compliance sign-off, which I'd expect to be rejected while the beneficial-ownership questions are open.

The shift is closed and the handover note is saved.
